quiz.q: 'මම මේක කලින් කවදාවත් කරලා නෑ.' (present perfect) — ඉංග්‍රීසියෙන්?
options: I never did this before.
I have never done this before.
I never done this before.
I am never doing this before.
quiz.explainSi: 'have + past participle' — present perfect, ජීවිත කාලය තුළ අත්දැකීමක්.
quiz.speak: I have never done this before.

quiz.q: 'මම එය ඊයේ ලැබුවා.' (නිශ්චිත, ඉවත් වූ කාලයක්) — present perfect ද past simple ද?
options: I have received it yesterday.
I received it yesterday.
I have receive it yesterday.
I receiving it yesterday.
quiz.explainSi: 'yesterday' වගේ නිශ්චිත ඉවත් වූ කාලයක් සමඟ past simple භාවිතා කරනවා, present perfect නෙවෙයි.

options: 'for' කාල පරාසයක් (three years), 'since' ආරම්භක ලක්ෂ්‍යයක් (2020)
වෙනසක් නෑ
'for' ආරම්භක ලක්ෂ්‍යයක්, 'since' කාල පරාසයක්
දෙකම අනාගතයට විතරයි
I already have eaten.
I have already eaten.
I have eaten already yet.
I have eat already.
quiz.explainSi: 'already' සාමාන්‍යයෙන් 'have' සහ past participle අතර යෙදෙනවා.

quiz.q: 'ජලය 100°C ට රත් කළහොත්, එය උනු පැන් වෙනවා.' (සැමවිටම සත්‍ය) — conditional?
options: If you heat water to 100°C, it boils. (zero conditional)
If you heated water to 100°C, it would boil. (second)
If you heat water to 100°C, it will boil. (first)
If you had heated water to 100°C, it would have boiled. (third)
quiz.explainSi: Zero conditional — සැමවිටම සත්‍ය විද්‍යාත්මක/සාමාන්‍ය කරුණු, 'If + present, present'.

quiz.q: 'මට ලොතරැයි ලැබුනොත්, මම ලෝකය වටේ ගමන් කරනවා.' (කිසිසේත් සිදු වීමට ඉඩක් නැති, ‘‘unreal’’) — second conditional?
options: If I won the lottery, I would travel the world.
If I win the lottery, I will travel the world.
If I would win the lottery, I travel the world.
If I had won the lottery, I would travel the world.
quiz.explainSi: Second conditional — 'If + past simple, would + ක්‍රියාව' — වර්තමාන/අනාගත 'unreal' තත්ත්වයන්.

quiz.q: 'මම ඉක්මනින් නැගිටියා නම්, බස් එක මගහරින්නේ නෑ.' (අතීත පසුතැවීමක්) — third conditional?
options: If I get up earlier, I don't miss the bus.
If I got up earlier, I wouldn't miss the bus.
If I had got up earlier, I wouldn't have missed the bus.
If I would get up earlier, I hadn't missed the bus.
quiz.explainSi: Third conditional — 'If + past perfect, would have + past participle' — අතීත 'unreal' තත්ත්වයන් සහ පසුතැවීම.

quiz.q: 'මේ පාලම 1990දී ගොඩනැගුවා.' (ක්‍රියාව කළේ කවුද කියන එකට වඩා සිදු වූ දේ වැදගත්) — passive?
options: This bridge built in 1990.
This bridge was built in 1990.
This bridge has built in 1990.
This bridge is building in 1990.
quiz.explainSi: 'was/were + past participle' — passive voice, past simple.

quiz.q: Active: 'They are repairing the road.' — passive?
options: The road is repaired by them.
The road is being repaired.
The road being repaired.
The road repairs.
quiz.explainSi: 'is/are being + past participle' — present continuous passive.

quiz.q: 'මම කවුරුත් නෑ' ඇය කිව්වා — reported speech?
options: She said that nobody was there.
She said that nobody is there.
She said nobody there.
She says that nobody was there.
quiz.explainSi: reported speech හි ක්‍රියා පදය එක පියවරක් අතීතයට යනවා — 'is' → 'was'.

quiz.context: The museum, which was built in the 1800s, has already welcomed thousands of visitors this year. If it hadn't been renovated last year, it would have closed permanently.
quiz.contextSi: 1800 ගණන්වල ගොඩනගන ලද ඒ කෞතුකාගාරය, මේ වසරේ දැනටමත් අමුත්තන් දහස් ගණනක් සාදරයෙන් පිළිගෙන තියෙනවා. එය පසුගිය වසරේ අලුත්වැඩියා කරලා නොතිබුනා නම්, එය ස්ථිරවම වැහෙනවා.
quiz.q: මේ වාක්‍යවල 'which was built' (relative clause + passive), 'has already welcomed' (present perfect), 'If it hadn't been...would have closed' (third conditional passive) — තුනම එකට එකතු වෙලා තියෙනවද?
options: ඔව් — b2-01, b2-02, b2-03, b2-04 හි රටා හතරම එකම ඡේදයේ එකතු වෙලා තියෙනවා
නෑ, 'has already welcomed' වෙනුවට 'already welcomed' විය යුතුයි
නෑ, 'which was built' වෙනුවට 'that build' විය යුතුයි
නෑ, third conditional වැරදියි
quiz.explainSi: 'which was built' (relative clause + passive), 'has already welcomed' (present perfect + already), 'If it hadn't been...would have closed' (third conditional, passive ස්වරූපයෙන්) — u5 හි සියලුම රටා එකට එකතු වෙලා තියෙනවා.

quiz.q: 'The manager told us that the report, which had been written by the new intern, would be reviewed tomorrow.' — reported speech, relative clause, passive — තුනම නිවැරදිද?
options: ඔව් — 'told us that...would be' (reported speech), 'which had been written' (relative clause + past perfect passive), 'would be reviewed' (passive) — තුනම නිවැරදියි
නෑ, 'which had been written' වෙනුවට 'which was write' විය යුතුයි
නෑ, 'would be reviewed' වෙනුවට 'will be reviewed' විය යුතුයි
දෙකම වැරදියි
quiz.explainSi: 'told us that...would be' (reported speech, 'will'→'would'), 'which had been written' (relative clause, past perfect passive), 'would be reviewed' (passive) — තුනම b2-04 හි නිවැරදි රටා.
